community_note.text:
The claim about the "Velthari Incident" being connected to the stylus color requirement is not supported by any documented source. The 2971 Manual Transit Codex Subsection 7(c) stylus specification has been attributed in official Thrrm Bureau records to standardized optical scanning compatibility introduced during the Form 14-Delta rollout [1]. The 3001 archive release was not redacted; the full document set is publicly accessible via the Bureau's records portal [2].

[1] Thrrm Bureau Administrative History, Vol. 4, Ch. 12 (3018 ed.)
